messages:
alex wong: Quick ping — PR #8722 is green locally but Buildkite is failing on windows-e2e. Can someone take a look? It's blocking the release train.

maria gonzalez: Looking now, did you try rerunning the job? Sometimes flakes clear with a rerun.

alex wong: Yep tried a rerun twice, same failure. Attaching the failing snippet below.

ci-bot: Buildkite job 4821 failed on agent windows-gpu-4
```
FAILED tests/e2e/test_session_timeout.py::test_long_running_query - AssertionError: expected 200 but got 504
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/e2e/test_session_timeout.py", line 78, in test_long_running_query
    assert resp.status_code == 200
AssertionError: 504 Gateway Timeout
```

jen li: That 504 looks like the runtime kv-cache eviction path. Did the PR change session keepalive or batching?

alex wong: Small change to batch window (from 20ms -> 25ms) to reduce GPU churn. Not expecting this.

sam o'neill: I can repro-ish on my Windows VM, give me 10. If it's a timing-sensitive flake we might add an xfail or extend timeout in the test while we root cause.

maria gonzalez: Quick thought — if this is an intermittent longer tail, we can do a hotfix: revert batch-window tweak and merge the revert to unblock. Then follow up with a proper fix. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

jen li: Revert sounds safest for the release. If sam can confirm it's the batch timing, I'll approve a revert PR and we can get it out.

sam o'neill: Confirming now — able to reproduce failure locally with batch window at 25ms after ~3 runs. At 20ms it passes consistently. Looks like a race in the kv-cache eviction TTL.

alex wong: Thanks Sam — filing revert PR now and will pin the e2e test with an issue reference. Sorry for the churn.

maria gonzalez: Thanks. Alex, drop the PR link when ready and I'll merge once CI is green.

ci-bot: New PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8730 (revert: revert batch-window change) — build triggered.

alex wong: PR #8730 here ^ — kicking off the revert. Will follow up with an issue for a proper fix and CC @eng-runtime.

jen li: Great, thanks. :thumbsup:

sam o'neill: If anyone wants to help root cause after the revert, I can pair and dig into the eviction timing tonight.

alex wong: Appreciate it — will set up a quick pairing slot.

maria gonzalez: Unblocking merge path. Marking this thread resolved for the release but preserving the follow-up work.
